nodes.description: Reflection balance mapping; mutated by _transferStandard on every transfer and used to compute balances and contract token balance.
ERC20 allowance mapping written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Blacklist mapping populated by setBots and checked inside _transfer.
Per-address cooldown timestamp mapping written using block.timestamp inside _transfer.
Total reflection supply, reduced by _reflectFee on every taxed transfer.
Reflection fee percentage mutated inside _transfer and consumed by _getValues.
Team/marketing fee percentage mutated inside _transfer and consumed by _getValues.
Fee wallet 1; also used as the authorization check in manualswap and manualsend.
Fee wallet 2 that receives ETH via sendETHToFee.
Uniswap V2 router address set in openTrading and used for swaps and liquidity.
Liquidity pair address created in openTrading and referenced in _transfer fee logic.
Flag enabling automatic contract-token swaps inside _transfer.
Flag gating the timestamp-based cooldown logic in _transfer.
Maximum transfer amount for non-excluded receivers, compared against amount.
Ownable owner address set from _msgSender() and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier around swapTokensForEth.
Trading state flag set to true by openTrading.
Core private transfer routine: applies bot checks, cooldown with block.timestamp, max tx limit, triggers swapTokensForEth/sendETHToFee and then _tokenTransfer.
Private function that approves and swaps contract tokens for ETH through the Uniswap router, guarded by lockTheSwap.
Private function that forwards the contract ETH balance to _feeAddrWallet2 via transfer.
Only-owner function that wires the router, creates the pair, adds liquidity with block.timestamp as deadline and enables swaps.
External function that lets _feeAddrWallet1 trigger swapTokensForEth on the full contract token balance.
External function that lets _feeAddrWallet1 trigger sendETHToFee on the full contract ETH balance.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and decrements the caller allowance.
Only-owner function that batch-adds addresses to the bots blacklist.
Private indirection that delegates the actual balance mutation to _transferStandard.
Private function that debits/credits _rOwned, takes the team fee and reflects the tax fee.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and as the transfer origin.
Miner/validator-influenced timestamp used for cooldowns and Uniswap deadlines.
External call to the Uniswap router swapping tokens for ETH; executed from _transfer before state settlement.
ETH value transfer to _feeAddrWallet2 inside sendETHToFee.
Timestamp-dependent state write that can be influenced by miners and bypassed or griefed.
External payable liquidity call in openTrading that forwards the entire contract ETH balance with a timestamp deadline.
Sender address parameter of _transfer, used for bots, pair and fee-exclusion checks.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer, used for bots, cooldown and pair checks.
Amount parameter of _transfer, compared with _maxTxAmount and forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
Token amount parameter that is approved and swapped via the Uniswap router.
ETH amount parameter forwarded to _feeAddrWallet2.transfer.
Array parameter of addresses written into the bots blacklist.
Sender parameter of transferFrom whose reflection balance is debited.
Recipient parameter of transferFrom whose reflection balance is credited.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used both for the transfer and the allowance subtraction.
Local caching balanceOf(address(this)) that is later passed into swapTokensForEth.
Local caching address(this).balance that is later passed into sendETHToFee.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from argument of _transfer through transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender for the allowance decrement and transfer origin in transferFrom.
manualswap authorizes on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1, so the caller directly controls execution.
manualsend authorizes on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1, so the caller directly controls execution.
The constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender(), making ownership caller-derived.
transfer invokes _transfer for every public transfer.
transferFrom invokes _transfer before adjusting allowances.
_transfer performs the router swap before balance settlement in _tokenTransfer, allowing external re-entry mid-transfer.
_transfer sends ETH out to the fee wallet before _tokenTransfer finalizes balances.
_transfer delegates the actual state mutation to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to mutate reflection balances.
block.timestamp is used to compute the cooldown deadline, a miner-influenced dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the Uniswap router call.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline in openTrading.
swapTokensForEth triggers the external router swap that transfers tokens out of the contract.
sendETHToFee performs the external ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH forwarding the contract ETH balance.
manualswap lets the fee wallet trigger swapTokensForEth, resulting in an external swap.
manualsend lets the fee wallet trigger sendETHToFee, resulting in an external ETH transfer.
The from parameter is used to index the bots blacklist, letting callers influence the gate.
The to parameter is used to index the bots blacklist, letting callers influence the gate.
The to parameter is read from and written to the cooldown mapping during transfers.
The to parameter keys the timestamp-dependent cooldown write.
The amount parameter is compared against _maxTxAmount to bound transfers.
tokenAmount is the amountIn supplied to the Uniswap swap call.
The amount parameter is the value forwarded by _feeAddrWallet2.transfer.
Each element of bots_ is written into the bots blacklist by the owner.
The sender parameter keys the reflection balance that is debited.
The recipient parameter keys the reflection balance that is credited.
The amount parameter determines how much reflection balance is moved.
The amount parameter is subtracted from the _allowances entry in transferFrom.
The uniswapV2Pair address is compared against from/to to branch the fee and cooldown logic.
uniswapV2Router is the external contract targeted by the swap call.
_feeAddrWallet2 is the recipient of the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
The timestamp-derived unsafe write stores the updated cooldown value into the cooldown mapping.
openTrading sets the trusted router address that all later swaps depend on.
openTrading creates and stores uniswapV2Pair, controlling later fee branching.
The cached contract token balance is passed as tokenAmount into swapTokensForEth.
The cached contract ETH balance is passed as amount into sendETHToFee.
The Uniswap swap causes token/pair transfers that can call back into the token's transfer logic while inSwap handling is mid-flight.
